data_fields.name: joint_turn_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: weapon 'turret turn' data value times ship multiplier (value not read in context)

data_fields.name: joint_turn_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: per-mount turnMultiplier added to ship multiplier (default not read)

data_fields.name: joint_arc_min_max
data_fields.donor_constant: mount arc from data, intersected with weapon arc, centred on base angle

data_fields.name: lifetime_subtraction
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 x shot lifetime, floored at zero

best_idea: Cap a joint's turn speed per step, clamp it to its arc so it never passes the limit, and pick the target by time-to-turn plus time-to-hit, so one look-at constraint serves a creature head, a hero arm or a weapon mount.
decision_why: The rate-capped, arc-clamped look-at with time-to-turn plus time-to-hit target choice fits creature heads and hero weapon arms as client-only cosmetics; the ship-turret parts (blind spots, idle sweep, harmonization) do not fit a biped and are not taken.
acceptance: In the Pit a creature turns its head toward its current target at its data turn rate and stops at its neck limit; a client test asserts the head changes by no more than rate x dt per frame and never leaves its arc; a server test asserts the same exchange resolves identically with the head aim forced to 0 and to 90 degrees.
